handoff_contract_choices: provider_resolver.REGISTRY_PATH: module-level path to the registry document, default the landed backend/src/provider_resolver/registry.json, read at call time and never written.

provider_resolver.event_channel(event_id): module-level function returning the event's ESPN broadcast channel short name (summary broadcasts media.shortName) or None; resolve() calls it at call time. Tests replace it; its production source is an open contract gap (P2B06T-DX-001).
Profile inputs: Settings.providerPref as landed by the TV app (A02): order (provider ids), confirmedAccess (provider ids), appOverrides, localMarket.

Selection: among registry providers whose channels_carried contains the channel and whose fire_os or vega package is in the latest detector report, pick the first in providerPref.order; registry (spike) order never overrides it. Local CBS/FOX/NBC without an installed carrier: channel only, provider and route null.

resolve() output: provider, channel, route (registry route with platform_routes.fire_os and .vega, each status verified or REGISTRY_ROUTE_GAP; verified entries carry their own package and launch), accessBasis, and inputs {installed, localMarket}. accessBasis is customerConfirmed only when the chosen provider is in confirmedAccess, otherwise unknown; nothing yields verified (no entitlement integration).
A registry platform entry without verified_outcome and verified_at is unverified and reads REGISTRY_ROUTE_GAP.

record_installed_apps(profile, packages) returns a mapping with packages; the latest report replaces the previous one and never edits providerPref. record_outcome(profile, event, outcome) returns a mapping with eventId and outcome; a value outside the six RoutingOutcome values raises ValueError; outcomes never change accessBasis.

observations.observation: CONTRACT GAP for P2-B06: DES-AFC-P2-RESOLVE lists the game broadcaster (ESPN summary broadcast field) as an input, but resolve(profile_id, event_id) is the frozen signature, the stored GameEvent shape (store.put_event allow-list, models/AFC-Data.sysml) has no broadcast/channel attribute, and B06's write set (backend/src/provider_resolver/, plus openapi.yaml under the Vega override) excludes store/ and feed_ingest/. The suite pins a module seam provider_resolver.event_channel(event_id); its production source needs a controller/owner decision (for example B02 storing the broadcast, or an amended B06 write set) before B06 can be green in deployment.
